name: When is the best time to purchase a new construction condo?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to purchase a new construction condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 'best' time to purchase a new construction condo depends on your priorities. Buying during the pre-construction phase often provides the most options for unit selection, floor plans, and customization, sometimes at a lower introductory price. However, this involves a longer wait. Purchasing closer to completion may offer a quicker move-in date and the ability to physically tour the finished unit, but with fewer choices and potentially higher prices. Consider your desired move-in timeline and customization needs to determine your optimal buying window.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time to buy a new construction condo depends on your priorities. Pre-construction offers more choices and potential savings but a longer wait, while closer to completion offers quicker move-in with fewer options.
